lane: Mobile + content: Bản đồ số result polish after Owner phone test (26/11/2026)
goal: Fix what the Owner saw on the phone on the Bản đồ số result: (1) the birth-date chart wrote a digit once per occurrence ('999', '11'), which reads like a wrong number; show the digit once with a count marker instead; (2) the chart and Hợp số readings were one-liners; add a richer per-digit reading (present, repeated, absent), a chart summary (how many cells, the strongest digit, the fullest row) and, for Hợp số, a two-person header with the relation of each compared number plus 'what each needs from the other' and a question for the two; (3) remove the 'chỉ lưu trên máy này / tính ngay trên máy' notices from the Bản đồ số screens, which the Owner says hurt trust in the result. Privacy behaviour (name in local storage only, the other person's data in memory only, no request) is unchanged; only the visible notices go.
successCriteria: A digit that appears 3 times shows as one digit with a '×3' marker (never '999'); the accessibility label still says how many times.
Tapping a cell shows a titled reading: present, a repeated note when it appears 2+ times, or an absent note for an empty cell.
The chart shows a summary line (cells present out of 9, the most repeated digit, the fullest row).

Hợp số shows a two-person header (Bạn / Người ấy) with the life path numbers and a relation badge; each compared number shows both numbers side by side with the relation, what each needs from the other, and a question for the two; still no score, %, ranking or 'hợp/khắc' in the results.
No 'chỉ lưu trên máy này', 'tính ngay trên máy', 'chạy trên máy này' or compat privacy box remains on the Bản đồ số screens; the private-message consent box stays.

New copy lives in packages/content/data/numerology-reading-extra.json, bilingual with accented Vietnamese, passes the banned-word list, and carries its own review block (draft until the Owner approves it); numerology-blocks.json and the deployed private-message function are not changed.
tsc, mobile jest suite and validate:data pass.
untouchedSurfaces: packages/content/data/numerology-blocks.json (Owner-approved 25/11, bundled in the deployed ai-numerology-message function) is not edited.
No Edge Function, SQL, migration, Admin, share card or storage key change.
calc.ts and compat.ts logic unchanged (golden cases stay as they are).
The private-message consent box and its wording stay.
